S53.18.needs: a Free account or a paid account, plus a skill whose description matches the request
S53.18.note: The auto-match runs on the server, not in apps/extension: applyImplicitManagedSkillOffer and selectOfferedSkills (apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/request-processor.ts:1082 and :5442, skill-offer.ts) add relevant skills to the system prompt on every surface except vscode, cli and api, so chrome is included. The extension only sends an explicit skillName chosen by hand (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts:15157-15180). The side panel does not show any message that a skill was matched, and I did not confirm how the result is labelled in the reply. The Code line's side_panel.ts:6916 points at unrelated keepalive code, and the freeTrialClient.ts:825 quote could not be found; neither affects this item.
steps: Make sure the account has skills of its own or in the catalog, and that the workspace allows skills.
Open the AGI side panel and send a request that closely matches the description of one skill, without choosing a skill in the Attach menu (the Skills entry, labelled "Skills", must stay unchecked).
Look at the reply: it should use the matching skill's behaviour, as the skill would be applied without being asked. Compare with Expected.
S53.18.where: No control of its own. The effect shows in a chat reply in the AGI Chrome side panel, when the prompt matches a skill's description.
